composition.subject: A tactile cutaway of an editorial AI architecture studio with six clearly separated production states

generation.modelLane: Codex image generation or the verified best available premium still-image lane
generation.capabilityReceipt: At execution, store the tool-returned model receipt; do not infer a model name from the harness
generation.prompt: Create a cinematic but restrained 16:9 editorial source layer for an AI architecture infographic. Show a tactile cutaway of a professional publishing studio where research becomes a semantic model, optional generated illustration, an exact publication master, dual review, and an accessible release packet. Use warm technical paper, graphite structures, restrained cobalt signal paths, and amber review light. Reserve clean surfaces for six later deterministic labels, one thesis, a source rail, and an accessibility note. The feedback path from review to the semantic model must have physical space but no generated arrow. No text, numbers, diagrams, logos, lab mascots, fake UI, dark command-center chrome, glowing brains, node-cloud filler, or all-caps poster styling. This is an illustration layer only; do not invent architecture relationships.
constraints: No generated arrows or causal connectors
No generated third-party marks or mascots
No dark AI-dashboard or generic neon-node aesthetic
Preserve clean negative space for exact publication overlays

deterministic.route: HTML/CSS or Figma master exported to PNG and WebP
